affinity.notes: Scales, horn, wood, mud, and metal establish a grounded neutral material palette.

anatomy.notes: Head, torso, arms, blades, and dorsal spikes are distinct.

archetype.notes: Bruiser or duelist does not communicate the intended mobile dorsal-gate duty.

counterplay.notes: Twin blades, low forward stance, and heavy dorsal armor cue an aggressive melee fighter best approached away from its front.

finish.notes: Cohesive scales, mud, armor, and restrained accent color.

framing.notes: Full stance is visible and the palisade echoes its silhouette.

identity.notes: Spined swamp lizard warrior identifies the Spineback form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T3; exact intended tier is T3.
